content: ffprobe/ffmpeg architecture cleanly separates libavformat (demux: av_read_frame yields AVPacket, header/container metadata via avformat_find_stream_info) from libavcodec (decode: avcodec_send_packet/receive_frame). ffprobe itself is a thin analysis layer; it does NOT define a formal 3-pass API but achieves the same effect by choosing how far to push data through the pipeline (stream info only vs -show_packets vs -show_frames triggering decode). No native 'union of declared passes' orchestrator exists in ffmpeg itself -- that's a design mediadiff adds on top.
